name: YAGEO-cc-np0
title: General-purpose NP0 multilayer ceramic chip capacitors, 16 V to 250 V, 0.22 pF to 100 nF
summary: A family of surface-mount multilayer ceramic capacitors in the class 1 NP0 (C0G) dielectric, in sizes 0201 to 1812, from 0.22 pF to 100 nF and rated 16 V to 250 V. Capacitance holds within ±30 ppm/°C from –55 °C to +125 °C. Terminations are nickel barrier with tin plating, lead-free; the parts are RoHS compliant and halogen free.

operation.text: A rectangular ceramic dielectric body holds a stack of interleaved metal electrode layers, which packs much capacitance into a small volume. Alternate electrodes reach opposite ends of the body and join the end caps, which are finished with plated tin over a nickel barrier (NiSn) and contain no lead.
Class 1 NP0 ceramic. Capacitance moves at most ±30 ppm/°C over temperature, and typical capacitance does not change with DC bias from 0 V to 50 V. Operating range –55 °C to +125 °C.
0.22 pF to 100 nF, rated 16 V to 250 V, in sizes 0201 to 1812; each size has its own set of capacitance and voltage ratings and a thickness class for each.
Capacitance and dissipation factor are measured at 1 Vrms and 20 °C: at 1 MHz for 1 nF and below, at 1 kHz above 1 nF. Insulation resistance is read after 1 minute at rated DC voltage.
Reflow soldering is recommended for every size; wave soldering for 0603, 0805 and 1206 only.
RoHS compliant and halogen free; moisture sensitivity level 1. Supplied on tape and reel (paper/PE or blister, 7 or 13 inch) or in bulk cases.
General purpose: consumer electronics such as tuners, television receivers and cameras; telecommunications; data processing.
1206 parts of 12 nF to 33 nF rated 25 V to 100 V are 0.85 ± 0.10 mm thick, with L1 3.2 ± 0.30 mm and W 1.6 ± 0.20 mm.
